name: Rewrite texts to apply specific literary styles
description: Users requested the rewriting or enhancement of specific texts to incorporate distinct stylistic elements, such as figurative language, allegory, specific author styles, or tonal shifts like poetic or humorous voices. They also asked for the refinement of narrative flow, sensory details, and character descriptions to improve emotional impact and readability.
